name: CircuPhyt
headline: CircuPhyt
description: A complex of plant venotonics that helps reduce heaviness and tiredness in the legs. It supports the strength of vein walls, helps prevent blood pooling and improves lymph flow.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule in the first half of the day, with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Diosmin, gotu kola extract, horse chestnut seed extract, blueberry extract, hawthorn fruit extract, ginkgo biloba leaf extract, excipients.
